title: Defensive protected-header parsing
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation. QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards: “Parsing the protected header necessarily happens before signature verification, which makes it an attack surface”.

statements.label: Defensive protected-header parsing
statements.requirement: Before the signature is checked, the verifier SHALL validate the types and lengths in the protected header: alg is a supported integer, kid is a byte string of the expected length, and no duplicate labels. It SHALL fail closed on anything unexpected.
